scope: Create a reviewable source branch without a JIRA issue. Prototype a local-core /discovery/fields endpoint that enumerates actual index field names, resolves explicit and dynamic field types, and reports exact per-field document counts for the live q+fq domain. Use field-type existence queries where supported and stored-field scanning for stored-only fields. Do not return field values or documents. The response must identify its local-core scope; collection-wide distributed aggregation, statistics, facets, pivots, and production safety guarantees are out of scope for this first step. Keep work in an isolated worktree based on upstream/main at 064d7ef8d7a7a4f4e7998aea14b3a6db49f865d1. Do not create a JIRA issue or public PR. Windows must not run Gradle or tests; push the branch and prepare exact-head Linux proof handoff.
summary: Prototype the first populated-field discovery endpoint
